summary: First full test run for RetailCLIQ Import app. All core flows tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 tests pass. Frontend: all 5 wizard steps, dashboard, batch detail, rollback modal all working. Fixed one critical bug in StepUpload.js (empty SelectItem value causing runtime error).

issues: Rollback button not visible on demo batches because they have no chunk documents in DB. This is expected behavior (committed > 0 guard), but could confuse testers. Demo seeding should include chunk documents for DEMO01 (Reconciled) to make rollback testable.

action_items: FIXED: StepUpload.js had empty string value in <SelectItem> causing Radix UI runtime error when column mapping rendered. Fixed by using '__skip__' sentinel value.
OPTIONAL: Demo batch DEMO01 has no chunk documents seeded — Rollback button won't show on it. Consider seeding chunks for DEMO01 to allow rollback demo flow.
critical_code_review_comments: StepUpload.js line 88: handleNext() calls api.post('/import/begin', ...) again instead of using the existing batchId — this creates a SECOND batch on every 'Next' click from step 2! The batchId from step 1 is already in ws.batchId but rows are inserted to that batchId. This is a logic bug — the begin call in step 2 creates an orphan batch.
CORS: allow_credentials=False with allow_origins=['*'] is correct but httpOnly cookie won't work cross-origin — app uses Bearer token in localStorage (rc_token) which is fine.
server.py line 693: post_batch uses BackgroundTasks parameter with default None — if background_tasks is None it would crash. Should use BackgroundTasks as a Depends.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all flows work, minor design note on demo batch rollback

seed_data_creation: Multiple test batches created during wizard testing. Total batches in DB: ~11

fixed_bug.root_cause: Radix UI Select.Item requires non-empty string value. Line 188 had value='' for the (skip) option.
fixed_bug.fix: Changed value='' to value='__skip__', updated Select value binding to use '__skip__' as sentinel for empty, updated setMap to convert '__skip__' back to empty string.

code_issue_unfixed.root_cause: handleNext() at line 88 calls api.post('/import/begin', {...}) which creates a NEW batch instead of reusing the existing batchId from ws.batchId. This means every time user clicks 'Next — Validate' a new orphan batch is created. The rows are correctly inserted to the original batchId.
code_issue_unfixed.impact: Orphan batches accumulate in DB. The original batch (from step 1) gets rows but the new batch from step 2 has no rows. The actual posting uses ws.batchId correctly though.
code_issue_unfixed.mitigation: Remove the api.post('/import/begin') call from handleNext in StepUpload — batch was already created in step 1.
